title: Buried Reads #1: Five Good Posts That Deserve More Attention
why_read: A curated roundup of underappreciated technical blog posts, useful as a discovery mechanism though it's secondhand content rather than original technical work.
analysis: This is a meta-post where the author manually reads low-engagement Dev.to posts and highlights the worthwhile ones, starting with a piece about reducing .NET garbage collector overhead via allocation strategies. The curation concept itself is a nice service for surfacing good writing buried under algorithmic engagement bias, but the technical value depends entirely on the linked posts, which aren't included here. As a standalone item it's moderately interesting mainly for the GC-reduction topic teased in the excerpt. It functions more as a pointer to other content than substantial technical material itself.
